subject: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU mapping, trial config, and co-sell registration
messages:
From: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@nubisretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-19T09:06:00Z
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing kickoff and co-sell intro

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Nubis Retail is excited to evaluate Redwood for an inference-backed product search pilot. Procurement asked me to kick off the Marketplace/contract side early so we can sync timelines with our internal POC (targeting Nov). Two asks to start:

1) Can you confirm the preferred Seller ID we should reference for co-sell registration?
2) What SKU mapping / trial SKU options do you recommend for a 30-day trial (we want a free trial SKU + paid subscription SKU)?

I attached a short pricing matrix with our expectations. If you can loop in someone from marketplace ops and legal that would be great.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call this week if easier.

— Rachel Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nubis Retail
rachel.chen@nubisretail.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@nubisretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-19T11:14:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing kickoff and co-sell intro

Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the note and the matrix. Short answers up front:
- Seller ID: use Redwood Inference seller ID 98765-RW (we'll also share the Seller Central link below).
- SKU approach: recommend a 2-SKU layout (trial sku: rw-trial-30d, paid sku: rw-core-monthly). The trial SKU should be configured as a 30-day private offer trial in AWS to avoid accidental billing.

Kimberly, Aditya — can you help with the AMI/container checklist and the private-offer footnotes for billing?

Rachel — attaching the AMI checklist we normally send to partners. Also included a quick MAP doc with fields we need filled on your side (seller org name, billing contact, SOC2 evidence request timing).

Propose a short sync Wed 10/22 10am PT to align. Does that work?

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: ami-image-checklist.pdf, mutual-action-plan-NU-0921.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@nubisretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-20T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing kickoff and co-sell intro

Thanks Marcus — looping in details. Rachel, quick notes from marketplace ops: 

- AMI vs Container: we support both. If your ops team wants BYO AMI, please follow the attached AMI checklist precisely (networking, IAM roles, version pinning). For container images, we need image URI and ECR permissions; container-based offering generally shortens listing time by ~2 weeks.
- SKU metadata: provide a clear 1-line usage example for each SKU (e.g., "Up to 100k inference tokens/month for search re-rank pilot"). This copy shows up on the product tile and is required for procurement.
- Trial configuration: recommend the free-trial SKU be non-billable and converted via a private offer to a paid SKU. AWS sometimes rejects trials that look like recurring free credits.
- Evidence: procurement asked for SOC 2 Type II date range and a sample retention policy doc.

I've sketched a recommended product page hero blurb below — short, benefit-led with a trial CTA. If you want, Aditya can run a quick pricing-footnote pass after we get your matrix filled.

Hero blurb (suggestion):
"Deploy high-throughput LLM inference for product search and recommendations with predictable latency and cost. Start a 30-day free trial to measure lift across your catalog."

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: pricing-guidance-notes.txt

From: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@nubisretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nubisretail.com
Date: 2025-10-20T13:01:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing kickoff and co-sell intro

Hi Kimberly / Marcus —

This is helpful — thank you. Couple follow-ups from procurement and our engineering lead: 

- We prefer container-based offering. I'll send ECR access today.
- Attached is our initial pricing matrix (nubis-pricing-matrix.xlsx) — note the trial should expose the same feature set as paid SKU for the pilot.
- SOC2: we can share our internal SOC2 snapshot but need to understand Redwood's requested evidence window. Procurement also asked whether Redwood can support a 60-day trial instead of 30 for Enterprise POCs — is that flexible?

If 10/22 10am PT is still good, I'll have our engineer and procurement join.

— Rachel

Attachment: nubis-pricing-matrix.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Chen <rachel.chen@nubisretail.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-21T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing kickoff and co-sell intro

Thanks, Rachel — quick notes before Wed: 

- 60-day trial: flexible but recommend we keep 30 days for the public trial SKU. For enterprise POCs we can provision a 60-day private-offer trial (no billing) tied to your account — that path gives procurement the extra time without confusing the marketplace listing.
- Evidence window: we ask for SOC2 Type II reports covering the last 12 months; sample retention policy and a schema for telemetry we collect. We'll provide a checklist for the evidence handoff.
- SKU tile copy: Kimberly's hero blurb looks good. Two small edits to reduce legal friction: remove "predictable" and change to "low-latency" to avoid guaranteed language on the public page. Proposed final: 

"Deploy high-throughput LLM inference for product search and recommendations with low-latency performance and cost controls. Start a 30-day free trial to measure lift across your catalog."

I'll attach the draft private-offer template in the Wed meeting notes and bring our legal contact if we need to redline billing footnotes.

See you Wed 10/22 10:00 PT (calendar invite coming).

— Aditya
Principal Product Manager, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Related links: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/registration/1234-ABCD (seller profile), DocuSign: https://docusign.com/NU-0921-proposal
